purpose: Measure how often the actual M5 feature-source clock makes the 96 observed-row model window longer than 480 elapsed minutes, and describe fixed 5m/60m direction scores by presence of a history gap.
predefined_populations: all pre-2026 parents, fold1 TRAIN parents 0:47602, fold1 later parents 47602:64890
predefined_comparison: gap count zero versus one or more in 96 source rows; fixed stored 5m and 60m predictions only, with own horizon masks
source_access: Hash the exact 2.46GB pre-TEST feature surface once, read only its time column, plus bound original target axes and saved OOF predictions. No feature values, M1 source, weights or model calls.
limitations: Window gaps and score differences are descriptive, confounded and have no uncertainty intervals; never infer cause, trading edge or a preferred horizon from this cohort. The source surface includes history before 2024 and pre-TEST development through June 2026; parent targets stay strictly before 2026.
